overview: WooCommerce uses Consumer Key and Consumer Secret for REST API authentication (HTTP Basic). You generate these keys from the WordPress admin panel. No OAuth flow is required.

steps.title: Log in to WordPress admin
steps.description: Access your WordPress site's admin dashboard at https://yourstore.com/wp-admin.

steps.title: Generate API credentials
steps.description: Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API. Click 'Add key'. Enter a description, select the user, choose the permissions (Read/Write/Read-Write), and click 'Generate API key'.
steps.tip: Select 'Read/Write' for full integration access including order updates.

steps.title: Copy the Consumer Key and Consumer Secret
steps.description: WooCommerce displays the Consumer Key and Consumer Secret once. Copy both immediately and store them securely.
steps.warning: The Consumer Secret is shown only once. If you navigate away without copying it, you must regenerate the key.

steps.title: Note your store URL
steps.description: Your store URL is the base domain of your WooCommerce site, e.g. mystore.com. This is required as connection config.

steps.title: Create the connection
steps.tip: Use a unique connection_id per WooCommerce store.

tips: WooCommerce REST API requires HTTPS — make sure your store has SSL enabled.
Consumer Keys are tied to a specific WordPress user — use a dedicated admin user for API integrations.
WooCommerce supports webhook delivery for real-time events like new orders.
warnings: The Consumer Secret is only shown once at creation — copy it immediately.
Ensure the API user has sufficient WordPress role permissions for the operations you need.
